text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — we need to bump the audit event contract to v2 next week. Primary changes: remove `actor_ip` (PII concerns), add `auth_context` object, and normalize `resource.id` to a dotted path. Need migration plan and customer-facing guide.

Samir Patel: Removing `actor_ip` will break some customers who rely on it for forensics. Any replacement? :thinking_face:

Maria Chen: Agreed re: forensics. Plan is to add `auth_context.hashed_ip` (HMAC with org-specific key / optional) and `auth_context.auth_method`. For private deployments we can't log raw IPs due to KMS retention policy.

Leo Nguyen: Proposal: support dual-format for 6 weeks. Ingest should accept both v1 and v2, emit `version` at root. SDKs provide an adapter. Example:```json
// v1
{
  "version": "1",
  "actor": { "id": "u_123" },
  "actor_ip": "1.2.3.4",
  "resource": { "id": "bucket-foo" }
}
// v2
{
  "version": "2",
  "actor": { "id": "u_123" },
  "auth_context": { "hashed_ip": "hmac:abc...", "auth_method": "oauth" },
  "resource": { "id": "storage.bucket.foo" }
}```

Jess Torres: We need to ensure the ingest validators won't silently drop v1 messages once we flip the schema. Otherwise customers will lose events.

Maria Chen: Ingest plan: validate both, tag with `ingest_version` and emit metrics `audit.ingest.v1` / `audit.ingest.v2`. After 6 weeks we set `reject_v1=true` behind a feature flag. Rollout: staging -> canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

deploy-bot: deploy: feature/ingest-audit-v2 to staging succeeded :white_check_mark:

Samir Patel: Customer-facing: we need a migration guide showing field mappings and examples, plus an org-level opt-in for hashed IP (since some customers will need PII for legal). I'll draft the guide. @Jess can you QA the examples?

Jess Torres: Will QA. I'll run a smoke test with org `acme-test` and verify old and new events are parsed and show up in the console timeline. Also can add regression suite to CI.

Maria Chen: Also add a fallback decoder: if `version` missing, try v1 parser first then v2 — to avoid drops during rollouts. Document rollback steps: flip feature-flag off, re-enable v1-only acceptance.

Leo Nguyen: SDK patch ready with `parseAuditEvent(event)` that returns a normalized object. Will open PR for `redwood-js-sdk` and `redwood-go` today.

Samir Patel: I'll handle support comms and the migration email. Note: include a KMS policy example for orgs that want hashed_ip HMAC key rotation.

Maria Chen: Good. Action items: Samir = migration guide + comms, Leo = SDK adapters PRs, Jess = QA + smoke, Infra = enable feature flag and canary policy. I'll sync with product to schedule the customer announcement for Thurs. :calendar:

Jess Torres: FYI — I'll also run a vuln-triage on any ingest path changes; if we add HMAC keys we need secret rotation docs and RBAC to limit access.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. If anyone spots customers using `actor_ip` in dashboards, ping me so we can notify them individually. :eyes:
